comment: At 1920 by 1080. File > Open on a 256 by 128 half-float EXR, a sky over a ground with a sun in it. The depth question is turned off so the panorama question is the only one. It comes once the picture has landed, with Keep Flat and Assign, Keep Flat the default. The state before the answer reads the document flat. Assign is pressed through click, and the state after reads it equirectangular in Blender's orientation, which Image > Projection... then shows, and Edit > Undo takes the assign back.
